text:
Marta: Short sync on schema decisions for chat/toolcalls/rerank. Need to finalize before spec freeze.
Sam: Goal: keep GA payload compact for PLG while supporting enterprise telemetry.
Alexa: Proposal: minimal envelope fields: payload, meta (model, model_version, trace_id), optional meta.flags list. No token counters by default.
PJ: Naming: enforce snake_case for JSON keys. Add CI lint to block mixedCase.
Dong: Ops rule: Dedicated/Private always return token counts. Hosted returns token_counts only when org opts in.
CSM_Patel: Large customers need 30d notice before enabling token telemetry. Add migration docs.
Sam: Suggest two tiers in spec: compact (default) and full_telemetry (opt-in). Document SDK flag flow.
Alexa: Tool-call response example (stringified in thread): {"tool_id":"org/name","status":"ok|error","result":...,"invocation_id":"rd-uuid"} and use rd-trace-id header.
PJ: Rerank items: {id, text, score, provenance[]}. Keep keys short to save tokens.
Marta: Launch checklist: spec PR, SDK examples, compat tests, canary rollout, customer comms + 30d opt-in process, legal signoff on retention.
ops-bot: Reminder: schema feature-flag deploy 2026-04-12 17:00 UTC.
Sam: Cut for Phase 1: drop attachments and rich_blocks. Phase 2 for richer payloads.
Alexa: I'll open PR with migration matrix and examples. Target: Thu morning.
Marta: Thanks all. Please comment on PR early if you see compliance/telemetry gaps. :thumbsup:
